scope: Replicate the existing Publish 14 Berserk I and II timed state into the client buff panel without adding the later-era melee damage modifiers carried by the retained NGE-derived berserk rows.

lifecycle.application: apply the presentation-only buff before the existing HAM transaction; abort without a debit if replication fails
lifecycle.rollback: remove the presentation buff if the HAM debit unexpectedly fails
lifecycle.expiry: remove the presentation buff before clearing STATE_BERSERK and its absolute-expiry objvar
lifecycle.relogin: remove stale orphaned presentation state or reapply it for the exact remaining absolute-expiry interval
lifecycle.cleanup: both identity-bound fixtures remove the presentation buff and prove that it is absent
